```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

```



```{r}
# some definitions

years <- 1997:2023
months <- 4:10
bio_i <- c(1998,1999)

raw  <- "../averages.tsv"
merged <- "../merged_data.csv"
fish  <- "../fish_removal_year.csv"
ss  <- "data/ss_monthly.csv"

z <- function(x) as.numeric(scale(x))
```



```{r}
#monthly grid
# check the working directory

grid <- expand_grid(Year = years, Month = months) |>
  left_join(read_csv(merged, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
              select(Year, Month, mean_temp, mean_depth, total_biomass),
            by = c("Year", "Month")) |>
  filter(is.finite(mean_temp), is.finite(mean_depth)) |>
  arrange(Year, Month) |>
  mutate(slot = row_number(),
         yr   = as.integer(factor(Year)))

YEARS <- sort(unique(grid$Year))
N <- nrow(grid)
J <- length(years)

temp  <- z(grid$mean_temp)
depth <- z(grid$mean_depth)

```

```{r}
# sample level

raw_i <- read_tsv(raw, show_col_types = FALSE) |> rename_with(trimws)

var_patterns <- c(chla = "^Chl", srp = "^SRP", din = "^DIN", sec = "^Secchi")
col_map <- sapply(var_patterns, function(p) names(raw_i)[grep(p, names(raw_i), ignore.case = TRUE)][1])

raw_long <- raw_i |>
  mutate(Year = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Year)),
         Month = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Month))) |>
  inner_join(grid |> select(Year, Month, slot), by = c("Year", "Month")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(unname(col_map)), names_to = "raw_var", values_to = "val") |>
  mutate(var = names(col_map)[match(raw_var, col_map)],
         log_val = log10(val)) |>
  filter(is.finite(log_val))

# observations into list(y, ix, K)
obs <- lapply(split(raw_long, raw_long$var), function(df) {
  list(y = df$log_val, ix = as.integer(df$slot), K = nrow(df))
})

#add monthly observed ss
ss_df <- read_csv(ss, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  inner_join(grid |> select(Year, Month, slot), by = c("Year", "Month")) |>
  filter(is.finite(SS), SS > 0) |>
  mutate(log_ss = log10(SS))

obs$ss <- list(y = ss_df$log_ss, ix = as.integer(ss_df$slot), K = nrow(ss_df))

# Grid-aligned SS covariate (with NAs for missing months)
ss_slot <- rep(NA_real_, N)
ss_slot[ss_df$slot] <- ss_df$log_ss
ss_cov  <- z(ss_slot)

# Zooplankton (from monthly grid)
zoo_df <- grid |>
  mutate(log_zoo = log10(total_biomass)) |>
  filter(is.finite(log_zoo))

obs$zoo <- list(y = zoo_df$log_zoo, ix = as.integer(zoo_df$slot), K = nrow(zoo_df))

```

```{r}
# addition of year level fish intervention

fishI <- (years %in% bio_i) - mean(years %in% bio_i)

dose <- tibble(Year = years) |>
  left_join(read_csv(fish, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
              select(Year, removal_kg_growseason), by = "Year") |>
  replace_na(list(removal_kg_growseason = 0))

fishR <- z(dose$removal_kg_growseason)

```

```{r}
# put the data in JAGS format

jags_data <- list(
  N = N, J = J, A = 0L,
  yr = grid$yr, temp = temp, depth = depth,
  fishI = fishI, fishR = fishR,
  
  # Observation vectors
  K_chla = obs$chla$K, y_chla = obs$chla$y, ix_chla = obs$chla$ix,
  K_srp  = obs$srp$K,  y_srp  = obs$srp$y,  ix_srp  = obs$srp$ix,
  K_din  = obs$din$K,  y_din  = obs$din$y,  ix_din  = obs$din$ix,
  K_zoo  = obs$zoo$K,  y_zoo  = obs$zoo$y,  ix_zoo  = obs$zoo$ix,
  K_sec  = obs$sec$K,  y_sec  = obs$sec$y,  ix_sec  = obs$sec$ix,
  K_ss   = obs$ss$K,   y_ss   = obs$ss$y,   ix_ss   = obs$ss$ix,
  ss_cov = ss_cov,
  
  # Prior centers (means) and scaling factors (SDs)
  srp_mn  = mean(obs$srp$y),  srp_sd  = sd(obs$srp$y),
  din_mn  = mean(obs$din$y),  din_sd  = sd(obs$din$y),
  zoo_mn  = mean(obs$zoo$y),  zoo_sd  = sd(obs$zoo$y),
  chla_mn = mean(obs$chla$y), chla_sd = sd(obs$chla$y),
  ss_mn   = mean(obs$ss$y),   ss_sd   = sd(obs$ss$y),
  sec_mn  = mean(obs$sec$y),
  
  # Empty legacy anchor placeholders
  nm = integer(0), anchor_idx = matrix(0L, nrow = 0, ncol = length(months)), 
  ss_anchor = numeric(0)
)

meta <- list(years = years, months = months, grid = grid, bio_I = bio_i)
```

  
```{r}
# save output

DIR_OUT <- "outputs"

# Ensure the output directory exists before saving
if (!dir.exists(DIR_OUT)) {
  dir.create(DIR_OUT, recursive = TRUE)
}

out_file <- file.path(DIR_OUT, "model_data.rds")
saveRDS(list(jags_data = jags_data, meta = meta), file = out_file)

# sanity check 
cat(sprintf("Successfully saved JAGS model data to '%s'\n", out_file))
cat(sprintf("Grid slots (N): %d | Years (J): %d\n", jags_data$N, jags_data$J))
```
